verdict.rationale: The only programmatic channel CRA documents is EFILE/ReFILE: system-to-system transmission of current, prior-year and amended T1 returns, available only through CRA-certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers. Every other UI capability has no documented API equivalent, including business registration (BRO), payments, direct deposit, enquiries, document submission, notices and representative authorization. Missing for 10: a general public API, API coverage of registration, payments, documents, enquiries and account management, direct user or AI-agent API access outside certified-software gating, and any parity documentation or independent corroboration.
